reviews.summary: HOT is in an active, just-launched HOT→HoloFuel migration/regulatory transition. Holo said key legal documentation and regulatory steps were still pending immediately before the November 1 launch, creating event and execution uncertainty for HOT now.
materialRisks: Major migration event: Holo’s HOT→HoloFuel swap went live around November 1 via Net Zero FZC under a provisional Zanzibar licence; transition mechanics and market response can materially affect HOT liquidity and pricing.
Official pre-launch update said executed legal documents, directors’ KYC, and other regulatory elements were still outstanding; this leaves current operational/regulatory execution uncertainty.

facts.fact: Holo’s official October 29 update, amended November 1, says the HOT/HoloFuel swap is operated by Net Zero FZC under a provisional licence from the Zanzibar Digital Free Zone regulator.
The same official update said the launch technology was built and tested, but user testing had been limited and ease-of-use could suffer initially.
Before the planned November 1 activation, Holo stated that legal documentation had not yet been signed and other regulatory elements, including directors’ KYC, were still in progress.
Holo’s status page reported Marketplace, Gateway, REST API, and Dashboard operational as of November 2; no current project-service outage was found.
